author: Ifmyante
text:
I'll show the trade management later on, because of what I did with Loon.

I had intended to hold Loon for a long time, but last week some very
strong pain killers took me by surprise, and made me want to just relax.
 So I closed my Loon so I could chill in peace.

I told the trading room I was closing my position, but didn't say why, so another of our traders closed his position too.

I feel so bad about this that I'm gonna keep my mouth shut in future

close" etc..)

BUT...it's very important for a trader to be not influenced by others!
Everyone must be responsible for their own trading decisions (and follow
 his own plan)

author: Muffles
text:
Hi IF,

Firstly, the zone which you looked to take a trade from seen in
screenshot 1 was a FTR after a break of the FL out of the flag (Also at
QM level).

Secondly, upon approach it signalled for you to look for an entry due to three reasons, seen in screenshot 2:

(1) Engulfed the last FL below signalling lower.

(2) FO above the last high into the FTR zone to capture more orders.

(3) Confirmed price was weakening through three drive.

Cheers,

Muffles
